text: {"question":"How might the application of an MB prior, as discussed in the second passage, influence the correlation between the Hubble constant and other cosmological parameters in the GDE model, whose correlation matrix is shown in the first passage?","reference_answer":"Imposing an MB prior tightens the allowed range of H0, which would reduce its degeneracy with other parameters in the GDE model.
